items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Black Benny used to come and try to get lessons from me.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never knew him either. I never knew Black Benny. I heard people talking.
I know all of them. Black Benny used to come and try to get lessons from me. And Zula Singleton. He's up Zula Singleton. Yeah, they call him Zula, yeah.
I knew him in New York.
